description: This file contains utility functions for Bluetooth device management, including device enumeration, address conversion, and address comparison within the Thunder project's Bluetooth namespace.

methods.name: BtUtilsHciForEachDevice
methods.description: Iterates over Bluetooth HCI devices matching a specified flag and applies a callback function.

methods.name: BtUtilsHciDevInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific Bluetooth device by its ID.

methods.name: BtUtilsHciDevba
methods.description: Gets the Bluetooth device address (BDADDR) for a specified device ID.

methods.name: BtUtilsOtherBdaddr
methods.description: Checks if a device's address differs from a given address.

methods.name: BtUtilsSameBdaddr
methods.description: Checks if a device's address matches a given address.

methods.name: BtUtilsHciGetRoute
methods.description: Finds the device ID associated with a given Bluetooth address.

methods.name: BtUtilsBa2Str
methods.description: Converts a Bluetooth address to its string representation.

methods.name: BtUtilsBachk
methods.description: Validates the format of a Bluetooth address string.

methods.name: BtUtilsStr2Ba
methods.description: Parses a Bluetooth address string into a bdaddr_t structure.

methods.name: BtUtilsBa2Oui
methods.description: Converts a Bluetooth address to its OUI (Organizationally Unique Identifier) string.

methods.name: BtUtilsBaswap
methods.description: Swaps the byte order of a Bluetooth address.
